text_fidelity_a: Hot Wheels id Smart Track Starter Kit with 3 Exclusive Cars, Track Pieces and Hot Wheels Race Portal for Physical & Digital Play, Gift for Kids Ages 8 Years Old & Up This is okay. If not for Vine, I'm not sure I would spend this type of money though. The one good thing is that there is some hand/eye coordination in play, so your children well get some development. You see they have to view an app, which shows a speedometer. They need to keep the needle at a certain speed. Speedometer graphics is broken down into 2 colors, blue and red. If you go to the red, chances are good your car will fly off the tracks. How do you control the speed? By pumping the booster. The faster you pump, the needle will move towards the red. So you need to time yourself and not pump too slow, or too fast to keep the needle in the blue at all times. My kids seem to think it's fun, so that's all that matters. But if you're an adult or an older child, I think you might get bored. Just pumping and watching the car go round and round. All the hardware is top notch. I won't subtract a star for thinking it's boring, since that's subjective.

text_fidelity_a:
Schleich Dinosaurs, Realistic Large Dinosaur Toys for Boys and Girls, Barapasaurus Toy Figurine, Ages 4+ As usual with Schleich toys, you can’t fault the durability or the quality. I’ve reviewed a number of them, and I can’t speak highly enough of their quality builds. They are made to last, even if roughly played with. We’ve had several now for about a decade, and they look no different than when they arrived, despite having gone through a number of dino “battles” and the like. This one is no exception. One issue I suppose is that it may be a little over-built in that it has quite a heft to it, which may preclude younger children from playing easily with it. It’s sizable already, but add the weight and I can see small hands having a difficult time picking it up and moving it around, or certainly moving it smoothly. Once you move past the toddler years, though, that will be much less of an issue.

In terms of looks, it’s nicely painted (again, as usual with Schleich), with the blue cuts running down central area from head to tail tip standing out particularly nicely. The pose is as if it is about to take a step forward or perhaps step on something (someone?). The face is my one real complaint about this model. It’s a raw sort of red color, which isn’t all that aesthetic. It almost looks like it’s been flayed, or perhaps is furiously angry. And there’s something about the mouth being open in the manner it is that just seems a bit off-putting.But at least the teeth look like the right sort (I hate when one has, for instance, obviously carnivorous teeth on herbivores).

It’s nice to have a new model and a relatively unknown one at that. Outside of the head/face, which is a relatively minor complaint, the barapasuaruk is another fine addition to a great line of toys/models.
text_fidelity_b: Schleich Dinosaurs, Realistic Large Dinosaur Toys for Boys and Girls, Barapasaurus Toy Figurine, Ages 4+

As he grows, there will be more and more for him to do. There are missions and villain takeovers and Gotham City news alerts to help create storylines and battles. Everything is interactive so when you want to put Catwoman in jail, assuming you can catch her anyway, you are actually putting her in a cell. Then you can let her break out and cause more feline mayhem. The play options are endless. I really feel that this is a must have for Batman/DC fans because it raises the play experience to a new level. Fisher Price always creates great quality toys and their Imaginext line encourages kids to use their imagination. In a world that is more and more dominated by phones and tablets, I can’t imagine a better way for a child to focus their energy and creativity than playing with a giant, interactive Bat Cave.
text_fidelity_b: Fisher-Price Imaginext DC Super Friends Batman Playset Super Surround Batcave with Lights Sounds & Phrases for Ages 3+ Years, 33 x 42 Inches

LEGO City Service Station 60257 Pretend Play Toy, Building Sets for Kids, New 2020 (354 Pieces) This LEGO CITY SERVICE STATION 60257 BUILDING SET (New 2020; 354 Pieces) is intended for kids aged 5 years and up, so it’s simple to build. Of course, that means there isn’t a lot of fine detail in the vehicles and buildings, despite the high piece count. Many of the 354 pieces are small ones, like single round studs for headlights, or a puppy figure, or a hot dog.

Still, this is a rather cool service station, because it includes a charging station for an electric SUV, in addition to gas pumps for a more traditional van. The set includes a mini-convenience store/pay station. The van opens up to show a spacious interior. Both vehicles can accommodate a minifig in the driver’s seat. There are 4 minifigs, including a station attendant.

I love all of the City sets, because they illustrate the ordinary jobs, workers, buildings, and vehicles that make up modern cities. The City sets are easy to build, their standard LEGO elements are interchangeable with other LEGO sets (not just the City sets), and they’re relatively inexpensive.

It's been a main request for birthdays and Christmas over the past year. For my 10 year old's last birthday, he requested a Nerf war. It was beyond fun to see the adults(of all ages) getting in on the fun right alongside the children. This one has a cool factor, since it's the longest Nerf gun at the moment and it truly is Mega. You can slide the barrel out to make it longer and slide it back in to make it shorter. It also has a bipod.

On the negative side, it takes up a great deal of room. It's a bit of a pain with its size. It's also so big that it's hard for my boys to use. I tried to use it and it's even awkward for me. I'd recommend this gun more for teens and adults. The only way my boys are really able to use it is with the bipod. It is a bit easier in the shorter length, but it's still heavy and awkward.

It also takes larger bullets than the average Nerf gun. It's a pain to have to worry about buying 2 separate kinds of bullets. All the rest of what we have take the same ones, and it makes things simpler. This gun comes with 10, but my boys lose darts constantly. Many times we discover where they were after the lawnmower turns them to confetti. Prepare for an extra investment if you don't already have other Mega guns.

Overall, if you don't mind buying the bigger bullets that go with this one and you or your child can handle the size, it's a pretty cool gun. My boys have had a hard time overly enjoying it, though, even if they do find it cool.

When I read the description of this product I had an "I should have thought of this first" moment. We live in a drafty, old house and unfortunately we have more than our fair share of spiders, tree beetles, silverfish and centipede freeloaders wandering around. Our son is fascinated with bugs and no matter how many he finds or how creepy the insect, he always wants to save it.

The bug vacuum arrives already assembled with batteries. So right off we were ready to use it. We've had the vacuum for just a few days and we have already liberated a giant furry legged spider that tried to Little Miss Muffet my husband as he was washing dishes. A slightly smaller relative was captured in the shower and a trapezoidal shaped stink bug was on the window in the living room causing our cat to make strange barking distressed noises. Kitty hates insects.

Each captured insect was studied from all angles, the clear plastic reservoir chamber is perfect for this, and then released into the wilds of our overgrown yard. Several insects were ones we were able to identify because we were able to study them. So this vacuum is not only useful it is hella educational.

Even storage is taken care of; the vacuum has a clip on the end perfect for hanging from a wall hook, we keep ours on a hook near the kitchen. I can't believe how ingenious this product is. I wish I'd known about it sooner.

text_fidelity_a:
CALOVER Gift Toys for Kids Cat Dog Remote Control Mock Rat Mouse Mice Prank Gag Funny Practical Joke Toy for Holiday Party Late last year, for a week or so, all 3 of our cats sat gathered around the stove in the kitchen just staring at it. I quickly figured that was probably NOT a good sign-that we likely had an uninvited guest in our home. A few days later, I was proven correct. Got up early one morning to take the dog out and there was a dead mouse by the front door waiting to greet me, with 2 of the 3 cats sitting close by, proud of what they had left for me. (I don't think I've ever screamed louder in my entire life than I did that morning! lolol-I did heap praise on them after I calmed down) Unfortunately, the cats were once again gathered around the stove watching...and a few days later, mouse #2 was waiting for us to clean up. (Thank God I didn't find that one)

As soon as I saw this cat toy, I immediately ordered it. Though one of our 3 cats who helped catch the mice has since gone to the Rainbow Bridge, I knew the other 2, Miss Piggy and Squeaky, would have loads of fun playing with this toy. (And if I'm being honest, I want to keep them in tip-top shape in case any further 'uninvited guests' find their way into our home! lol) The mouse (I see it more of a rat than a mouse) is nearly 11 inches long from the tip of the nose to the end of the tail. It has beady red eyes that light up. From a distance, I believe people (who don't know its fake) could mistaken it for a real mouse (rat). It has gray fur and what appears to be sharp teeth sticking out of its mouth. (The teeth are NOT sharp, they only appear that way) The mouse takes 3 AAA batteries (not included) and the remote controller takes 2 AAA batteries as well. (not included) The only assembly required is placing the batteries in the mouse and controller. A nice, small screwdriver comes with the toy, something I especially appreciate! (Works on my eyeglass hinges as well!) The controller allows you to move the mouse forward and backward. (Both of our young kids were able to operate the remote control without issue while we stood with them) It does work on carpet but works far better on flooring. As soon as we turned it on and began steering it around the room, 2 cats immediately popped out of their beds, their curiosity piqued. Both cats watched the mouse zip around the floor for a bit. As soon as it got close to Miss Piggy, she jumped and ran under the bed. lol. But Squeaky...he was far braver than Piggy and watched it up close. We'd stop it for awhile and he'd creep closer and closer to it, staring at it....and then we'd start it up again. lol. It was loads of fun to watch him with this toy. It certainly kept him entertained for quite some time! Piggy stayed hidden but she's a nosy cat...she'll get the hang of it before long.

This is a fun toy not only for cats but for cat owners to operate for their cats! We had loads of fun watching the cat's reaction. Its a great way for your cat to get some exercise as well. Very easy to operate also!

UPDATE******************

We got this out again tonight to play with. This time, the dog had more fun chasing it than the cats. However, after just under 15 minutes of use, it stopped working entirely! Even though I had used brand new batteries in the mouse and the controller when I first got it (a day ago), I replaced all 5 batteries. It does NOT work at all. Nothing happened to it. It did not fall, it didn't' crash, it was not damaged in any way, it simply stopped working altogether in the blink of an eye. And that's a darn shame because my cat AND dog had fun with it. Due to the fact that it stopped working entirely after just under 30 minutes of total use since we got it, and the fact we did nothing to break it/make it stop working, I've changed my rating/review of this item. I cannot recommend an item that stops working out of the blue as this did. For the minutes that it did work, my pets loved it. And we loved watching them have fun.
text_fidelity_b: CALOVER Gift Toys for Kids Cat Dog Remote Control Mock Rat Mouse Mice Prank Gag Funny Practical Joke Toy for Holiday Party

text_fidelity_a: Hasbro Gaming Scattergories Board Game I have two teenagers who spend a lot of time in their rooms. We have the occasional game night once or twice a month for some quality family time. This game has become my 16 year old daughter's absolute favorite game. She has even started having her friends over for game night. You roll the dice and whatever letter comes up is the letter that each word that you write has to start with for that round. You are given a card that tells you what to write. For example, the card may say "a color" for number 1. The die was rolled and it landed on the letter G for that round. So you have to write down a color that starts with G on your list. Now if you and anyone else write the same G word, neither of you get a point. You are trying to come up with the most original and creative word that fits the letter and the subject. It's usually hard to come up with all twelve words in a round when the timer is set! We all enjoy this game!

Furreal Friends Dizzy Dancers Dance Champs 2pk - BUNNY PACK Kids often like toys best that offer movement of some kind. Flashing lights and sounds also have a certain appeal, but at the very least there needs to be some type of moving action. Furreal Friends Dizzy Dancers is a toy that offers some action and many youngsters will take to this toy right away once they learn how it works.

Furreal Friends Dizzy Dancers includes one pink and one purple bunny. To get the dancers dancing, all you do is insert one of the plastic slides into the bunny, then pull it out quickly. This gets the pointer on the base spinning fast. Like a top, you then place it on a smooth, flat surface and let it spin. The toy offers Mechanical operation, so no batteries are needed.

Furreal Friends Dizzy Dancers are action- oriented and I was surprised by how long the dancers continue to spin like a top after a single pull from the plastic slide. Provided you pull the slide out quickly, the dancers will continue spinning for a while. One game my kids like is to spin both of them at the same time, then sit back and see whose bunny is spinning the longest. They have come up with a few other creative games also, and this surprised me a little at first because the toy seems so simple.

My girls find this toy amusing, but one thing I noticed is that, unlike their other toys, Furreal Friends Dizzy Dancers has little staying power. That is, the spinning just isn't enough to keep my kids interested for long. At first, it seemed like fun watching the bunnies spin and making up games but after the first week, their interest had tapered off considerably. The simplicity of the toy is nice and I am grateful that it takes no batteries, but after one week, the bunnies have already been relegated to the bottom of the toy box.

Kids like toys that move, but apparently a toy that spins and does little else just doesn't have enough action to matter. I still find the Furreal Friends Dizzy Dancers good enough to recommend a little, but I can understand why some people will rate this toy below average. Kids love it at first, but their interest falls rapidly once they realize how little these bunnies can actually do.
text_fidelity_b: Furreal Friends Dizzy Dancers Dance Champs 2pk - BUNNY PACK

text_fidelity_a: Halloween Lights- 24 pcs Halloween LED Necklace Bracelets Pumpkin Ghost Pirate Spider Eyeball Necklace Halloween Party Favor Light up Flashing Decoration Trick Treats Gift Bag Fillers for Women Men Family Pack There are 24 different Halloween themed pieces in the box, ranging from pumpkins, to ghosts, to pirate ships, to spiders, to skulls.  The necklaces have a simple snap clasp at the end, and the bracelets have two different size settings.  The lights have three different colors including red, green, and blue.  There are three different setting to the lights with how they flash.  When first turned on, all three of the colors work great.  All the red, green and blue lights work at first.  But after about 10 minutes, the blue light starts to fade, then the green light starts to fade, until only the red light is working.  If turned off and left to sit and rest for a while, then all three light begin to light up and work again, but eventually again only the red light will remain lit.  This happened with all of the necklaces and bracelets in the box.  So as long as the lights are not needed to stay on for long periods of time, they are nice.  If needed for longer periods, two bracelets or necklaces or one of each could be used to alternate between them to give each one a rest by turning it off to refresh the colors.  So if handing these out for Halloween treats, I would recommend giving kids two in order to compensate for the lights not working all the time.
text_fidelity_b: Halloween Lights- 24 pcs Halloween LED Necklace Bracelets Pumpkin Ghost Pirate Spider Eyeball Necklace Halloween Party Favor Light up Flashing Decoration Trick Treats Gift Bag Fillers for Women Men Family Pack

Klutz Felted Friends Craft Kit I purchased this for my cousin's daughter, who at six is considerably below the age recommended. In terms of skill I think she can handle the assembly instructions - one might object on the grounds of the pokey-stabby tool used for the felting, and while she did poke herself a couple times during the install, her parents fared considerably worse.

Speaking of which; she produced a fuzzy friend (the bunny - purple, to be specific) within an hour of trying. The project went well, though her father managed to break two of the needles during the trial-and-error phase, so I'll have to replace those. She seemed to have some fun with it, especially since she was able to assemble the bunny with her parents. There is also a certain amount of observation involved - you have to watch and learn the art of felting, which I think is a good experience for a kid; obviously it didn't take too long, but then my sister was also assisting and she knows all about material/felt/stitching/quiliting and that sort of stuff.

Overall, I would say it makes a good gift. It is, as described, easy to get into and produces a walnut to kiwi-sized fuzzy animal with maybe thirty-minutes of actual work. Probably best for kids over the age of six, though.

Would recommend for gifting to first cousins once-removed.
text_fidelity_b: Klutz Felted Friends Craft Kit

You don't need to own anything else if you have this, because it includes two fully ready-to-play decks.

One of those decks, as advertised on the box, is Mewtwo. The other is not Melmetal - it is the same Pikachu deck from the Battle Academy set, including the same book from that set that will teach you about half of the rules of how to play.

It also comes with sleeves - one set for Mewtwo, and the other for Melmetal, which is strange considering that he's not in the box.

I just started playing the game with my nine year old daughter, and the one deck will certainly help add to our collection of decks, but you need to know what you're buying here. The Battle Academy set includes three decks, not two, and is similarly priced to this set, and will give you multiple "how to play" books that will help teach you the ropes. I'd start there.

Just My Style Name Bracelet Maker by Horizon Group USA I think this kit is just "ok". My 6yo was far more impressed than I was.
My main problem with this kit is that there is no way anyone could string these beads. All thread included is far to thick for the tiny bead holes. My daughter was excited to use a real needle for the first time though. Pictured next to the needed is a needle threader (threaders can be picked up for $1 at your local box if they still have a sewing dept).
The string she used to make her bead bracelet was silky smooth. It made the beading process easier... but the bracelet broke three minutes after she finished. I triple knotting it off too and that wasn't strong enough to keep the knot together. I'd recommend dotting the knot with a drop of glue or clear nail polish to make it hold.
In addition, I think this kit is divided in half; made for two different age groups. Younger children who would be interested in beading part probably won't be ready for friendship braclet weaving for a few more years. And just the same, I think older girls might find the beading process too juvenile. So if your looking for a friendship bracelet kit, I don't see a lot of value in this kit.
These is also a lot of excess packaging to make what you get seem bigger than it is. I feel like this is something that I would have pick up at five below, so $13 feels overpriced to me.
(My daughter wanted to use her own round letter beads; but she could have used the square letter beads that came in this kit just the same)
text_fidelity_b: Just My Style Name Bracelet Maker by Horizon Group USA

Unsolved Case Files: Cold Case Murder Mystery Game: Who Murdered Harmony Ashcroft? | Can You Solve The Crime? The only reason this isn't a 5-star review is the racist casting in the mystery that had nothing to do with the story.

A friend gave this to me knowing my love for true crime. I've always wanted to try the Hunt a Killer boxes, but was always put off by the price.

No spoiler review:
- The case file includes newspaper clippings, evidence files, interview transcripts, photos, and more. Your first puzzle is to prove the innocence of Bones, the only non-white person in the game who was a homeless drunk that was wrongfully accused and jailed for the crime. (Obviously, racism is very much a problem with our justice system in real life. However, depicting that in a fictional puzzle game? We'll never solve this problem if we continue to portray that happening. Furthermore, there was NO STORY REASON WHATSOEVER for it.)
- You select your answers to the puzzles on their website, and if you're right you can open the first seal additional evidence envelope. I was worried the answer selection would spoil the real answers, but we didn't have to worry about that at all.
- We ended up becoming so invested in the case, after a couple hours in we decided to sleep on it and solve the first puzzle the following day. We couldn't stop talking about it.
- Once you play it once, you can't play it again. However, you don't have to mark any of the evidence so you can easily just put everything back in the envelope and give it to a friend. For the price as well, that's a lot better than most true crime puzzle games that are WAY more expensive.

text_fidelity_a:
CVCBSER Smooth Swing Dueling Lightsaber, Increase Motion Control 12 Sets Sound Effect Light Saber, with 16 Colors Changeable Premium Metal Handle Lightsabers for Adults and Boys Gift (Silver) [[VIDEOID:acf24d91cee31c0de845571b6cd24d7b]] This is a very nice light saber. Good heft to it with lots of features. There will be a learning curve, but hopefully my tips as well as the video demo will make it easier for you. Remember that it is all in the blinking:

After assembling and charging your saber, you start off in SLEEP mode, meaning NOTHING should be illuminated. Hold the power button until the power ring illuminates and you hear a voice saying POWER ON. Now this is called OFF/AWAKE mode. Off meaning the lights/effects are not turned on yet, but the power button ring is illuminated. More on this OFF/AWAKE state later. But here, you simply tap the button to turn on the lights and effects. Now you are in ON/AWAKE mode, and here are the commands for ON/AWAKE mode:

ON/AWAKE MODE COMMANDS:
-------------------------------------
ONE BLINK: Hold the button until it BLINKS one time, then release. LOCK-UP effect is now enabled. It basically sounds like your saber just hit some electrical wires and is going crazy. Tap the button to get out of it.

TWO BLINKS: Hold the button until it BLINKS twice, then release. The saber will cycle through the color choices. Once you like a color, tap to set your color choice.

THREE BLINKS: Hold the button until it BLINKS three times, then release. You will hear a quote from the movies. To hear a different quote, hold until it BLINKS three times again, then release. Basically keep holding and releasing after three blinks to cycle through the quotes.

FOUR BLINKS: This turns OFF the lights/effects. But, the power ring is still illuminated, which means you are back to OFF/AWAKE mode, and here are the commands for OFF/AWAKE mode:

OFF/AWAKE MODE COMMANDS:
--------------------------------------
ONE BLINK: This allows you to set the sound volume. You can set between NO SOUND, LOUD SOUND, and SOFT SOUND.

TWO BLINKS: This is for light effects. You can have it STABLE, UNSTABLE, or PULSE. Stable gives a consistent solid light, which is what I have on during my demo because it's easier to capture on video.

THREE BLINKS: This is for setting a theme music. You can cycle through 5 songs, and the 6th is no music. So if you leave it at any one of the songs, whenever to turn on the lights/effects, music will be on too. So if you don't want any music, make sure you cycle all the way to no music.

FOUR BLINKS: You can cycle through more movie quotes, one of which is, "The force is with you Luke..."

LASTLY, to put it sleep. Hold the button for 10 seconds, so when you do this. It will go through its blinking, but just disregard them until the red illumination is completely off. This takes about 10 seconds. You are now in SLEEP mode. The same mode as when you first assembled and charged the saber. To play again, hold the power button until it illuminates, and you are back to OFF/AWAKE mode.
text_fidelity_b: CVCBSER Smooth Swing Dueling Lightsaber, Increase Motion Control 12 Sets Sound Effect Light Saber, with 16 Colors Changeable Premium Metal Handle Lightsabers for Adults and Boys Gift (Silver)

It has a lot of pieces, but they’re mostly small pieces (1 or 2 studs). Mixed in are some specialty pieces (e.g., Unikitty’s cloud stole, the golden scallop shell, the piano keyboards) that require considerable creativity to be used in other projects.

As an adult Unikitty fan (don’t ask me why!), I love the new Unikitty figure. She has fancy boots, and two different faces. One face has sunglasses, the other has a starry-eyed expression. Unikitty’s cloud stole adds a touch of elegance.

The finished pirate figure, with all of its one-man-band instruments, stands up solidly. This is a tribute to the designer, because the arms and back have a lot of weight to support. The arms and legs can be repositioned in their ball-socket joints.

If you download the Lego Life app (available for both iOS and Android), you can scan the maze code on the front of the printed instructions and get building instructions for an “Intergalactic Drum Set” (see photo). This uses parts from the basic build, and extends the building fun. Scanning the maze code also provides the set’s building instructions, in case you prefer to build from a tablet or cellphone display.

text_fidelity_a:
Imagine Meditation Kit for Kids - Award-Winning Mindfulness kit of XL Cards with Calming Guided Meditations for Empowerment, Focus and Relaxation. Great for Parents, Teachers and Therapists. This kit was made to help families like ours. I am a stay at home mom to four kids (11yo and younger). Prior, I was an artist and earned a Special Ed and a Rehabilitation degree. My background has been useful because we ended up a household full of ADHD, severe anxiety, learning and speech disabilities, plus more. We have been using this set for three weeks now and it has proven invaluable. It truly was an excellent find.

We do not own the original set (with the Dove on the box), but I suspect this new version is probably an upgraded improvement of the first box set. It looks very similar, except now there appears have some new (maybe better) ideas and slightly more guidance in this new version. I don't mean to imply this set is a duplicate of the first set, nor am I trying to discourage you from buying both. I simply don't know. I came to the conclusion that these were similar after reading the reviews for the first one. Had I been given the option to chose between the two sets, I would have chosen to start with the newer set I am reviewing here today. Simply because of the changes that were made.

ABOUT THE PRODUCT:

- Most of the cards appear to have between 200 to 300 words. Each activity lasts about 5 minutes per card, give or take. Of course each could be longer or shorter because you get decide how much time you want to spend.

- This newer set has a total of 24 meditation activity cards. 18 of the 24 are guided scenarios. The 18 cards are "story like, short guided imaginary meditation with different scenes that people can imagine themselves taking a part of.” Meaning they ask you to concentrate and imagine yourself in a particular story line (like "walking through the woods" or "stargazing on a warm summer night", for example).
- 6 of those 18 cards mentioned above focus on our senses (touch, taste, etc).
- In addition to the above 18, there are 6 more "positive affirmation" cards. These affirmations address different times of day (morning or bedtime) -or- feelings (anger, stress, etc).

OTHER COMPARISON NOTES:
- From what I can tell, the original set only appears to have 23 guided imaginary "walk through the woods" type scenarios. It does not specifically explore common human experiences that center around feeling or our body.
- The Legend Card is unique to this set. The Legend is more of a guide chart that will help you quickly find the most useful card, depending on the your feelings/needs at the moment­.
- Both sets have the same breathing exercise card.

MY POSITIVES:

- This set is excellent quality. The cards are very nice and are made of a thick paperboard. They are technically laminated, though it wouldn't consider it a plastic waterproof type of covering. It feels more like a wax coating that is water resistant. But it is a sturdy material.
-This truly is an activity for all ages. Kids 6 and younger will probably need guidance. Around 6 or 7, this could probably be an independent activity for most kids. But this mediation set is NOT just for kids. I think pre-teens, teens, and even adults can still benefit from these cards. I wish I made more time to use them myself, tbh.
- These have been excellent in helping everyone in our house decompress and cope with our daily stressors.
- I think this encourages and even teaches how to use our imaginations better (an essential skill!!!).
- It has increases our awareness of self worth. And in a sense, these also teach us to take responsibility for some of our thoughts and feelings too. These activities seem to encourage future motivation and action too.
-This kit is secular and inclusive. Meaning it is not religions in any way. And Many people are represented in the images. The language the cards use, and the activities are age and gender neutral. The suggested scenarios are something anyone can envision.
- And the art is beautiful.

THE NEGATIVES:
- The box is terrible. It's too small. It's impossible to find the one card the Ledged Guide tells you to grab without taking out the entire stack. And it's a pain putting the cards away. I'm going to have to come up with a better storage system.
- There are spelling mistakes, improper punctuation, and unnecessary capitalization. If it had been here or there, I wouldn't have said anything. Nor am I in a position to judge. But it's really bad and does not feel educational.
- The price feels a bit steep initially. However, I think if you make it a goal to give this set a real try and use it for a little while, I think you'll see the $30 price tag actually feels like a good deal.

text_fidelity_a:
SwimWays Paddle Paws Spring Float Dog Raft, Large (65 lbs. and Up), Blue This isn't really the proper review as I just received this product yesterday, but I did want to point something out for others maybe thinking of this product so they can get a fuller vision of it.

1st - it came ridiculously fast so shipping = excellent. I purchased on the Sunday before Memorial day and received the item the following Wed. afternoon with Amazon's Super Saver free shipping.

And now to the product -

Obviously I'll have to update this review with durability, but for now I can say that I took my dog out on it yesterday (the day we got it) and her monster-claws (that need a serious trim which she will receive today!!) didn't even phase this thing.

The part that's concerning me about this product is just how much water the dog sits in while floating. My dog LOVES water and so of the two choices of dog-float that Amazon offers I figured this was the better choice because the other one doesn't look like the dog gets wet at all and I figured that would get pretty hot for the pup. And even though there are many good pics for this item, I guess I was still envisioning that the dog would be floating with maybe an inch or two of water in the bottom - just enough to keep her cooled down. That's not the case. For my 100# girl, she is laying in about 4-5 inches of water at all times. Cooling? yes, but comfortable? I'm thinking no, not for a dog; at least not for any real length of time. Buyers should be aware that the pic with the Portuguese Water Dog (that I thought was only THAT full of water because the dog is laying over the edge of the float) is a perfectly accurate pic of just how much water the dog will be sitting in at all times while on this float.

In the future hopefully someone will come out with a product that offers just a little LESS contact with the water to create a more perfect balance of cooling and comfort for the dog.

UPDATE: So I actually purchased this for a tubing trip that the dog was going to come along on, which we did this weekend.

End result for this product: The river was super low so we had a LOT of the dog jumping in and out as we'd hit rocks, a LOT of dragging over long distances of rocks, and some fast moving water - over endless rocks! lol I know this wasn't the intention of this product but as far as any 'ripping' there was absolutely none - and we couldn't have put this thing through it's paces any more than that river trip was!! But as far as the durability of the small ring that makes this hold it's shape - that broke just while refolding the item and I learned quickly how important that was within about 30 minutes on the river. :( The product won't hold it's shape very well at all without it. Oh, also, the air stopper kept randomly coming open and not due to the rocks, just whenever, even in calm water. So that was a problem too.

As speculated in the original review, the dog did NOT like being in that much water for an extended amount of time, AND the fabric seemed to almost stretch out a bit because she sat lower and lower (in more water) the longer we were on the river.

Now, all that said, in a pool, I think this product would do just fine - where the dog could get out whenever it got sick of laying in so much water - but I still do think the plastic ring will snap in a heart beat just due to regular un/folding, and needs to be rethought by the manufacturer.
text_fidelity_b: SwimWays Paddle Paws Spring Float Dog Raft, Large (65 lbs. and Up), Blue
